en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is not a fetter (*no-saṃyojana*), a non-wholesome state that is not a fetter arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) …pe… dependent on a wholesome state that is not a tie (*no-gantha*),

a non-wholesome state that is not a tie arises by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a wholesome state that is not a flood (*no-ogha*), a non-wholesome state that is not a flood arises by way of root condition.
... pe ... dependent on a wholesome state that is not-yoke, a non-wholesome state that is not-yoke arises by way of root condition;
... pe ... dependent on a wholesome state that is not-hindrance, a non-wholesome state that is not-hindrance arises by way of root condition;
... pe ... dependent on a wholesome state that is not-attachment, a non-wholesome state that is not-attachment arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition: one [answer] … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition: one.
